Blockly vendored bundle for `sf blocks` (offline classroom use)
`sf blocks` 用にベンダリングした Blockly バンドル（オフライン教室運用）

Version   : 13.1.1 (latest stable on npm at download time)
Downloaded: 2026-07-13

Files and their source URLs:
  blockly.min.js
    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/blockly@13.1.1/blockly.min.js
  msg/ja.js
    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/blockly@13.1.1/msg/ja.js
  LICENSE (Apache-2.0, blockly.min.js/msg/ja.js have no LICENSE file inside
  the npm package itself, so it is taken from the matching GitHub tag)
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/blockly/blockly-v13.1.1/LICENSE

Loading idiom verified by inspecting the downloaded files (do not guess from
memory — this bundle's internal wiring changed across major Blockly
versions):
実際にダウンロードしたファイルを調べて確認したロード方法（記憶で推測しない —
このバンドルの内部配線は Blockly のメジャーバージョンで変わる）：

1. blockly.min.js is FOUR concatenated UMD modules (core, English messages,
   built-in blocks library, JavaScript generator), each wrapped in its own
   `;(function(root, factory){ ... }(this, function(){ ... }))`. Loaded as a
   plain <script> tag (not a module), each module's "Script" branch runs in
   order and wires itself onto the previous one:
     - module 1 (core):        `root.Blockly = factory()`
     - module 2 (en messages):  merges into `root.Blockly.Msg`
     - module 3 (blocks lib):   `root.Blockly.libraryBlocks = factory(root.Blockly)`
                                 (as a side effect of running, this also
                                 registers every built-in block, e.g.
                                 controls_repeat_ext / math_number, into
                                 `Blockly.Blocks`)
     - module 4 (JS generator): `root.javascript = factory(root.Blockly)`
                                 `root.Blockly.JavaScript = root.javascript.javascriptGenerator`
   So after a single <script src=".../blockly.min.js">, both `Blockly` and
   `javascript` (with `javascript.javascriptGenerator`, `javascript.Order`)
   are on `window`.
   blockly.min.js は4つの UMD モジュールを連結したもの（コア／英語メッセージ／
   組み込みブロック集／JavaScript ジェネレータ）。<script> タグ（module では
   ない）として読み込むと "Script" 分岐が順に走り、上記の通り前段に配線される。
   1本の <script> 読み込み後、`window.Blockly` と `window.javascript`
   （`javascript.javascriptGenerator` / `javascript.Order`）の両方が使える。

2. msg/ja.js MUST be loaded with a separate <script> tag AFTER blockly.min.js
   (its "Script" branch does `for (key in messages) root.Blockly.Msg[key] =
   messages[key]`, i.e. it patches the already-created `Blockly.Msg`
   in place — loading order matters).
   msg/ja.js は blockly.min.js の"後"に別 <script> で読み込むこと（既存の
   `Blockly.Msg` に日本語訳を上書きするだけなので順序が重要）。

3. The JS generator instance is `javascript.javascriptGenerator` (also
   aliased as `Blockly.JavaScript`); custom block generators are added via
   `javascript.javascriptGenerator.forBlock['drone_takeoff'] = (block, gen) => ...`.
   JS ジェネレータの実体は `javascript.javascriptGenerator`
   （`Blockly.JavaScript` としても参照可）。カスタムブロックの生成関数は
   `javascript.javascriptGenerator.forBlock['drone_takeoff'] = ...` で登録する。

4. Workspace persistence: `Blockly.serialization.workspaces.save(workspace)`
   / `.load(state, workspace)` (JSON) — confirmed present at
   `Blockly.serialization.workspaces`.
   ワークスペースの保存・復元は `Blockly.serialization.workspaces.save/load`
   （JSON 形式）が使える。
